singleSourced.key: dice and from what i ve heard respawn are working on battlefront 3
singleSourced.value: Dice and, from what I've heard, Respawn are working on Battlefront 3.
singleSourced.context: Joe Brammer claims in a recent social media post that " Dice and, from what I've heard, Respawn are working on Battlefront 3." He adds that, if we assume this to be true, he's "not sure what that means for Battlefield." Brammer doesn't elaborate on his source, and neither EA nor Lucasfilm has confirmed a new Star Wars Battlefront game.
